content: Storage RLS mirrors DB RLS via policies on storage.objects. Common 403s stem from 3 causes: bucket public/private setting, missing SELECT policy on storage.objects, or confusing getPublicUrl() (works only on public buckets, returns non-functional URL for private) with createSignedUrl() (correct for private). Signed URLs must be generated server-side only, are time-limited, and RLS should still restrict who can request a signed URL for a given path.
